verdict.rationale: Jan documents connecting to external cloud model providers (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Groq, etc.) so users can use large frontier models without downloading them locally, and explicitly frames this as switching between local and cloud models without vendor lock-in. However, this is BYO-API-key integration with third-party providers rather than a first-party 'hosted cloud tier' offered by Jan itself, and there's no evidence of Jan-hosted inference infrastructure. Missing for 10: evidence of a Jan-operated hosted cloud tier (vs third-party API connections), and independent confirmation of this offload workflow in practice.
